name: GestureMancerKing
summary:
GestureMancerKing is a gesture-based XR magic game that brings spellcasting into mixed reality.

Players use natural hand movements to gather energy and perform magical abilities. By combining different gestures, players can learn the fundamentals of magical combat and experience immersive XR interactions.

Features:
• Gesture-based spellcasting
• Energy gathering and magic release
• Immersive mixed reality gameplay
• Hand tracking interaction
• Early access to the world of GestureMancerKing
